alt: Real ChatGPT /gapfinder execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /gapfinder Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-question gap-finding widget on training versus inference. Let me enter answers and reveal expected explanations. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Correct the first claim: training updates parameters, ordinary inference uses them.
Reveal the first expected explanation and compare it with the correction.
Read the first expected explanation and its chapter reference.
Correct the second claim by distinguishing new context from learned parameters.
Reveal and read the expected explanation about prompt context.
Correct the retrieval claim without confusing retrieved context with training.
Reveal and compare the third expected explanation.
Inspect the completed counter: three answers and three explanations.
Reset the written responses and explanations for another attempt.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
